scope_guards: The wider structured capacity remains 1,193 dwellings and 198 is not added to it.
Only the Trocoll House subsite is evidenced as permissioned in the structured note.
The 2015 and 2020 198-home records are application lineage, not two separate 198-home schemes.
The 2021 headlease decision relates to the same up-to-198 homes and is not additive.
Thirty-five percent affordable housing is a subset of 198, not additional homes.
Borrowing, net present value and lease terms are finance/asset evidence rather than wider-site permission.
A point and ownership category do not establish exact HMLR title topology for the whole EA area.
No score or promotion is written until remaining cases, exact geometry, title relation and overlays are verified.
